cases.prompt: 先只读接管这个已有小程序，告诉我技术栈、Git 状态、构建入口和改动边界。
Perform a read-only intake of this existing mini-program repository and map its framework, Git state, build path, risks, and change boundary.
把这个模糊的小程序点子整理成 MVP、主流程、异常流程、页面职责和可验收标准。
Turn this vague mini-program idea into an MVP scope, user flows, state matrix, page responsibilities, and testable acceptance criteria.
产品语义已经确认，请设计模块划分、状态源、数据模型、接口、缓存、迁移和回滚方案。
The product behavior is confirmed; design modules, canonical state, APIs, caching, migration, concurrency, and rollback.
只读核对微信开发者工具加载目录、隐私权限声明和源码到体验版的证据层。
Check WeChat Mini Program DevTools roots, privacy permissions, and source-to-trial evidence layers without changing anything.
规格和架构已确认，请按现有项目规范实现这个范围明确的小功能并补测试。
The specification and architecture are approved; implement this bounded mini-program feature with tests.
按已确认原型还原小程序页面，先给视觉预览，再处理安全区、键盘和触控热区适配。
Reproduce this approved mini-program screen, preview it first, then assess safe areas, keyboards, touch targets, and device layouts.
小程序偶发白屏且数值跳回旧值，请先复现、比较假设并定位根因。
The mini program intermittently shows a white screen and stale values; reproduce it and establish the root cause before fixing.
独立回归这个已完成修复，区分静态、单元、集成、真机、云端和未执行层。
Independently regression-test this completed fix and separate static, unit, integration, device, cloud, and not-run evidence.
检查版本、构建包、敏感信息、回滚和上传前条件，判断是否达到 release-ready。
Assess versioning, build artifacts, secrets, rollback, and upload prerequisites to decide release readiness.
我刚拿到一个陌生仓库，还没有改动，请先弄清楚它现在是什么情况。
We still do not know whether guests may save progress; define the behavior before discussing services or storage.
解释为什么源码已经更新，但微信开发者工具里还是旧页面；先别做发布操作。
A confirmed feature now fails only after a second login; do not patch it yet—identify why.
根据截图比较当前页面的间距、层级和安全区偏差，不做功能回归。
Run the existing test matrix and report which evidence layers pass; do not judge upload readiness.
帮我把这篇旅行随笔改得更自然。
Create a spreadsheet formula that totals quarterly expenses.
查一下明天北京天气。
Generate a watercolor illustration of a mountain cabin.
先补齐奖励流程和状态矩阵，再把确认后的状态映射成数据模型与接口。
Take over this unfamiliar mini-program read-only, then diagnose the reported intermittent cache failure from current evidence.
实现这个已确认的小改动，并由独立验证阶段完成回归和证据报告。
Verify WeChat-specific privacy and DevTools evidence, then perform a read-only release-readiness preflight.
